Nothing was run on the phone.

acceptance.1_driver: session_reset_canary.py: pins both package-002 candidates (RECOVERY, Image.payload and its length, offset 2048) per --image; in the real tree, with no docs/decisions/*-nat046-<image>-single-run-*.md, every mode (preflight, --execute, --restore) and both images stop before the first adb call (RealTreeGate); the gate requires exactly one decision file naming both hashes and decision 0019 and never creates it; with a decision file in a scratch tree: read-only preflight writes nothing, --execute writes, reads back in full, starts the watcher and waits for its start record, then sends one `adb reboot recovery` (the fake adb checks the watcher log at the moment of the reboot, with a deliberately slow watcher too), leaves a one-shot marker per image, readback mismatch and a watcher that cannot start restore stock and never reboot; the driver differs from the NAT-037 driver in exactly the 13 enumerated lines and keeps its safety lines.
acceptance.2_watcher: usb_watch.py: appear/disappear/re-enumeration (devnum change)/string change, vendor filter, root hubs and interfaces skipped, partial enumeration deferred, no serial in the log, no device-node access (static + attribute-read spy), one fsync per line, existing log refused, SIGTERM stop record, SIGKILL leaves whole lines; the detached watcher outlives the driver and sees later events.
acceptance.3_analyzer: analyze_reset.py: the verdict table with every boundary (deadline, split point 95-(wdt-deadline)/2, baseline 95 +- 10 s, coverage 120 s), refusal to judge without T0 or a covering log, other vendors ignored, baseline constants tied to the nat-022 README text, CLI reads the real build-002 record.
acceptance.4_mutation: mutate_nat048.py: 68 mutants of the three scripts in a mirror tree (private artifacts/nat-022 and nat-048 so parallel mutants do not share the driver's flock); 68 killed, 0 survived, 0 invalid. The first attempt shared the lock and every mutant 'died' of a crashed driver: the false kills were found by reading the first kill reason, and the mirror tree was fixed before the run recorded here.
